info.title: Calculator (web)
info.description: The Calculator built the new way: a Svelte client on the kit's buttons, and the arithmetic in Luau.

x-app.description: Arithmetic: type or tap a sum. The Calculator as a web client on a Luau backend.

methods.name: press
methods.summary: Press one key: answers with the keypad's next state and what to show. The backend keeps nothing; the client holds the state and sends it with each key.

params.name: state
params.description: The state the previous press answered with; absent for a calculator that has just opened.

Keypad.description: Where a sum has got to. Opaque to the client: it keeps the last one and sends it back.

entry.description: The number being typed, as typed.

value.description: The number shown once a result is in (fresh).

numbers.description: The sum so far: its numbers ...

ops.description: ... and the operator after each of them.

waiting.description: An operator was just pressed and waits for its operand.

fresh.description: The display holds a result; the next digit starts a new number.

Screen.description: What a press leads to: the next state, and what to draw.

display.description: The big number, formatted, or Error.

caption.description: The sum so far in words, or the reason for an error.

clear.description: The clear key's label: C while a number is being typed, else AC.

pending.description: The operator waiting for its operand (drawn pressed); absent when none is.

error.description: Why the sum failed (Can't divide by zero); absent when it did not. The client announces it.
